application_point_definition: COM local point + (0, 0, offset_z); lateral X resistance only is applied there; longitudinal Z and any Y component stay central.
experiment: Nordic 28 P2.12 hull lateral resistance application-point experiment
known_force_and_torque_limits: Hull resistance is calculated once and its components are applied once; the local resultant is checked against the calculated vector.
Yaw torque is about rigid-body local +Y; known measured moment sum includes explicit cached moments only and is not the complete engine solver net moment.

profile_validation.profile_mutation: none; application offsets are set through a test-only runtime method
